top_stories.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Sub-Classification of Scheduled Castes
top_stories.summary: The Supreme Court held that states have the constitutional authority to sub-classify Scheduled Castes (SCs) to provide targeted reservations for the most backward communities within these groups.
key_takeaways: Invoked Article 14 (Equality before Law) to justify sub-categorization.
Emphasized that sub-classification must be backed by empirical data on inadequate representation.

top_stories.title: NISAR Mission: NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar Deployment
top_stories.summary: Joint Earth-observing mission between NASA and ISRO entering final integration phases to track systemic changes in Earth's land and ice surfaces.
key_takeaways: Uses dual-frequency radar (L-band and S-band) to map the entire globe every 12 days.
Crucial for monitoring ecosystems, ice sheet collapse, and natural hazards like earthquakes and landslides.
First hardware collaboration between NASA and ISRO on an Earth-observing mission.

top_stories.title: Great Nicobar Island Development Project & Ecological Concerns
top_stories.summary: The mega-infrastructure project at Galathea Bay faces heightened scrutiny regarding its impact on the Shompen indigenous tribe and critical marine biodiversity.
key_takeaways: Includes an International Transshipment Terminal, an airport, and a power plant.
Impacts Galathea National Park, a primary nesting site for the Giant Leatherback Turtle.
Highlights the conflict between strategic maritime positioning and ecological conservation.

top_stories.title: Red Sea Shipping Disruptions and Global Supply Chain Impact
top_stories.summary: Continued security threats in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait force maritime vessels to reroute around the Cape of Good Hope, inflating freight rates and delays for Indian exports.
key_takeaways: Rerouting adds 10–14 days to trade routes between Asia and Europe.
Increases insurance premiums and fuel costs, affecting India's agricultural and engineering exports.
Underscores the geopolitical significance of chokepoints under UNCLOS frameworks.

top_stories.title: Sovereign Green Bonds (SGBs) and Climate Finance Strategy
top_stories.summary: The RBI and Ministry of Finance continue expanding the issuance of Sovereign Green Bonds to mobilize capital for green infrastructure and renewable energy transition.
key_takeaways: Proceeds are mapped directly to public sector projects lowering carbon intensity.
Supports India's Panchamrit targets (500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030, Net-Zero by 2070).
Encourages foreign portfolio investment in India's sustainable finance ecosystem.
